title: Sectoral Analysis: Understanding How Different Industries Behave
description: A sector-by-sector guide to how Indian industries actually make money, what drives their earnings, and why the same ratio means completely different things in a bank, an IT services firm, and a cement maker. Built for experienced retail investors, mutual fund investors, and salaried professionals who already know the basics of reading financial statements and want to analyse stocks and sector funds with an industry lens. Covers NSE sectoral indices, cyclical vs defensive behaviour, sector-specific KPIs and valuation multiples, and sector rotation, using real Nifty sector data, Screener.in, and listed Indian companies throughout.
